_meta.description: Flagged irregularities and unverified items. Published on the Flagged for Review page. None of these block the merge (per the user's instruction). 'Needs review' means the user should decide.

flags.title: Category commission rate unverified (blank on all rows)
flags.detail: The official Standard Commission Income schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in. Third-party sites disagree (Kitchen is listed at 4.5% by one and 5% by another), so no rate was entered. Earnings and commission potential cannot be calculated until the rate is read from the schedule in an authenticated Associates account. Re-tested on 2026-11-14: the schedule URL still redirects to an Amazon sign-in page, so the rate remains unread.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central, read the rate for the category Amazon assigns to these products, and send it for entry.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings withheld from the public site
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(b) allows prices and availability to be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API. Section 3(t) bars star ratings and review data unless obtained the same way. The verification read prices and ratings, but they are not published. The pricing and rating analysis the brief asks for therefore cannot be shown on a static site.
flags.action: Decide whether to (a) apply for PA-API / Creators API access, which requires review of its license terms (not reviewed in this pass), or (b) accept price and rating fields as withheld.

flags.title: Associates tag not visible in the resolved links
flags.detail: All three short links resolve to Amazon product URLs with tracking parameters (lv, channelId, plpRedirect, btn_ref) but no 'tag=' parameter. Commission attribution to the user's Associates ID therefore cannot be confirmed from the page.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central that each link was generated under the user's Associates ID. Send the tagged canonical URL if the short links do not carry the tag.

flags.title: Short-link codes do not match the ASINs they resolve to
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are not ASINs. They resolve to B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. The ASIN from the resolved URL is used everywhere on the site.
flags.action: Confirm each resolved ASIN is the intended product.

flags.title: P2 brand: confirmed from the Item details table; byline to confirm
flags.detail: The P2 page's Item details table (read 2026-11-14) lists Brand Name 'Emeril' and Manufacturer 'Emeril Lagasse'. The earlier verification recorded a store name 'Emeril Store' and a byline 'Innovation IQ'. Neither string appeared in this session's snapshots, so neither is used on the site.
flags.action: None needed for the brand. Optional: check the byline on the live page if you want it shown.

flags.title: Capacity units differ between title and specification
flags.detail: P1 title says '6 Quart' but the specification says '6 liters'. P2 title says '26QT' but the specification says '24.6 liters'. Units were not converted, so the two values were left exactly as listed.
flags.action: Confirm the capacity the manufacturer states (quarts or liters) before using it in comparisons.

flags.title: Colour differs between title and specification (P1)
flags.detail: The title ends in 'Black'; the specification table lists 'Black, Gray'.
flags.action: Confirm the colour option the user intends to promote.

flags.title: P3 is a size-variant family
flags.detail: The P3 page offers size options of 6, 8 and 9 quarts. The short link resolves to the 8-quart variant (ASIN B08DKYBTPH, with variation parameter th=1). Capacity values on the site are for the 8-quart variant only.
flags.action: Confirm whether the user wants the 8-quart variant or the family.

flags.title: Snapshot was taken for a US delivery location
flags.detail: The product-page snapshots were read with a US delivery location set. This does not establish the user's location or intended storefront. Prices and availability may vary by delivery location; no location-specific prices or availability are published.
flags.action: Confirm amazon.com is the intended storefront before promotion; if another marketplace is intended, verify its product links and local program terms.

flags.title: 'Sponsored' labels on the also-viewed lists are inconsistent across snapshots
flags.detail: P1 (channelId=500 snapshot): 'Sponsored' sits directly above the 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' heading. P2 (two snapshots read 2026-11-14): no label sits above that carousel; 'Sponsored' appears above 'Brands in this category'. P3: 'Sponsored' appears above 'Deals on related products'. The competitor lists may include paid placements, and the labelling changes between snapshots.
flags.action: Treat all three competitor lists as unverified organic competition data.

flags.title: Verification method may conflict with Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use licence excludes collecting and using product listings, descriptions or prices, and excludes data mining and robots. This verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. The site keeps only identifiers, brand, category and a few specification fields, and does not publish prices or ratings. Scaling this approach (for example, automated product research) would need legal review.
flags.action: Review with counsel before any automated product research. Prefer PA-API / Creators API data or manual entry.

flags.title: AI content automation is restricted by Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use bar using AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. The planned AI article generation has therefore NOT been built. It must be reviewed before it is connected to any Amazon-derived data. Related: Participation Requirements Section 5 and IP License Section 1 also bar machine-learning use of Special Links and Program Content (F-17).
flags.action: Decide the data sources for AI-generated articles and get a compliance review before automation.

flags.title: Earlier Pages workflow failure (resolved; root redirect is used)
flags.detail: An earlier 'Deploy static site to GitHub Pages' workflow failed before creating jobs. The repository's Pages source is main root (/); the root index redirects to docs/index.html. The failure was resolved by replacing the deployment workflow with site checks and confirming the subsequent Pages deployment succeeded (deployment details are in COORDINATION.md).
flags.action: See COORDINATION.md for the successful deployment and site-check run links.

flags.title: Prior prototype records superseded
flags.detail: The prototype pages from earlier sessions (root index.html, products.html, insights.html, flagged.html) held blank product records and an unverified status. They are replaced by the verified records in this site (git history keeps them).
flags.action: None.

flags.title: Trend, popularity and conversion signals are unverified
flags.detail: The product pages show Amazon badges (for example 'Amazon's Choice' and 'bought in past month') and rank-like signals. These are not published, because reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics was not confirmed (F-02). No official source provides verified trend or conversion data for these products, so trend and conversion fields are blank.
flags.action: Provide an official data source (for example, PA-API) or accept blank fields.

flags.title: Creators API / PA API terms partly reviewed
flags.detail: Read 2026-11-14 from the Program Policies, IP License: Section 1 (use limited to the site and to Amazon product pages; no ML model development), Section 2(b) (an Associates tag and key pair are required for API calls), Section 2(c) (principal purpose must be advertising and driving sales on an Amazon Site), Section 2(e) (no aggregation, analysis, extraction or fine-tuning without express prior written approval), Section 2(h) (caching limits) and Section 2(k) (text disclaimer). Not read: the separately linked Specifications and any data-feed terms. No API integration is claimed.
flags.action: Read the Specifications and data-feed terms before any API work. Obtain API credentials only if you decide to use PA-API.

flags.title: Machine-learning use of Amazon data is barred without express written approval
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 5: no Special Links or Program Content may be used to develop machine learning models or related technology without express prior written approval. IP License Section 1: Program Content may not be used, directly or indirectly, to develop or improve large language or multimodal models, machine learning models or related technology. IP License Section 2(e): no aggregation, analysis, extraction or repurposing of PA API data, and no direct training or fine-tuning of a machine learning or foundational model, without express prior written approval. The brief's AI-powered product analysis and article generation fall under these limits if they use Amazon data. The Conditions of Use also bar AI-generated content from Amazon Services being used to develop models (F-12).
flags.action: Do not train, fine-tune or analyse Amazon-derived data with AI. Request written approval before any such use, or keep AI work to non-Amazon data.

flags.title: Autonomous agents must identify themselves and meet the Agent Terms
flags.detail: IP License Section 4 (Agent Terms) applies to any software that takes autonomous or semi-autonomous action to access or use Program Content. An agent must identify itself in its user-agent string as 'Agent/[agent name]', must not conceal that it is an agent or mimic human keystrokes or navigation, must answer truthfully when asked whether it is a human, and must not circumvent measures that block or limit agents. Amazon may also limit agent access at its discretion (Section 4(b)).
flags.action: Before any AI agent is built to access Amazon pages or data, design it to meet Agent Terms Section 4 and obtain a compliance review.

flags.title: Program Content may only promote Amazon products and link to Amazon pages
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 3(z): no Program Content may be used to advertise or promote products offered on any site that is not an Amazon Site. IP License Section 1 and Section 2(c)(iii): each use must link only to the relevant Amazon page. Planned comparisons and buying guides that include non-Amazon products would need to keep Program Content out of those sections.
flags.action: Keep Amazon product data and links separate from non-Amazon product content in any comparison or buying guide.

flags.title: Amazon text disclaimer may apply to displayed listing text
flags.detail: IP License Section 2(k): where Product Advertising Content consisting of text is displayed, the site must show Amazon's disclaimer that the content comes from Amazon, is provided as is, and is subject to change or removal. This site shows Amazon listing titles and specification text that were read from product pages, not from PA API. Whether that text counts as Product Advertising Content has not been determined.
flags.action: Decide whether to show the disclaimer on the product pages. Showing it is low-cost and removes the question.

flags.title: Manufacturer not confirmed for P1 and P3
flags.detail: The Item details table was read for P2 (Manufacturer 'Emeril Lagasse'). For P1 and P3 it was not read in this session, so the manufacturer field is left blank rather than inferred from the 'Chefman' brand.
flags.action: Read the Item details table on both pages, or accept the blank.

flags.title: Automation goals need PA-API / Creators API access and Associates eligibility
flags.detail: The brief asks for automated research, AI article generation, publishing, and click and conversion tracking. Program Policies Participation Requirements Section 2(b) limits price display to Amazon-served links or PA-API / Creators API data. Section 3(s) bars artificially generated clicks, including by robot or software program. Section 3(t) bars customer reviews and star ratings unless obtained through Creators API or PA API. No PA-API or Creators API credentials, Associates tag, or analytics access exists for this site, so these features are not built and no values were filled in to simulate them.
flags.action: Obtain Associates / PA-API access and confirm eligibility before any automation is connected.
